protagonist.who: You are a temporary morning assistant at a small town bakery, hired for the week before the owner decides whether to repaint the display case and reopen the shop as a plain takeaway counter.
protagonist.wants: to find out who is leaving the marked loaf in the display each morning and why, before the owner makes the decision.
protagonist.can_do: set up the display case, inspect the loaves, read the order slips, ask regulars and staff about the mark, and move a note from one shelf to another.
protagonist.cannot_do: make the owner open the back office, make the head baker say what she knows, or stop the loaf from appearing if it is being left by someone with a key you do not hold.

arena.description: A small bakery on a rain-washed street, with a display case, a proving room, and a back office full of order slips and old recipe books.

pressure.description: The owner will decide at the end of the day whether to repaint the display case and turn the shop into a plain takeaway counter, and the marked loaf is still appearing in the case before then.
pressure.clock_or_stock: none tracked: the owner's decision is told through events, because 3-0c licenses only incorrect_resolution

opposition.wants: to keep the shop calm and the sale of the new counter smooth, without the marked loaf becoming a story that confuses the regulars or the buyer.
opposition.means: controls the back office key, the display case lock, the staff rota, and the only record of the old order slips.

mediation.question: What is the marked loaf for, and what will you let it mean?

to_reach_pole_a.pole: follow the human lead: find the person leaving the loaf and learn the personal reason
to_reach_pole_a.what_you_must_do: get the owner to open the back office, match the note's hand to a regular or staff member, and ask that person why they are leaving the loaf before the owner decides what to do with the display case.
to_reach_pole_a.cost: the owner has to choose between the ritual and the sale, and the person who left the loaf has to say it in front of the regulars.

to_reach_pole_b.pole: follow the physical lead: find the ordinary cause of the loaf and let the personal meaning rest
to_reach_pole_b.what_you_must_do: check the order slips, the supplier's delivery note, and the display case lock, and settle on an explanation that does not require the owner to reopen the back office or the regulars to speak up.
to_reach_pole_b.cost: the answer is true but thin: the loaf is explained, and the person who left it is not asked why.

levers: the note tucked under the loaf

turns.situation: On your first morning, the marked loaf is already in the display case with a note tucked under it, and the owner has locked the back office before telling you the buyer is coming that afternoon.
turns.what_you_must_do: find out what the mark means before the owner asks you to remove the loaf

ways_through.way: you learn it from the supplier's delivery note in the proving room, because you match the mark to an old supplier symbol
ways_through.cost: the mark is read as a delivery mark, and the note's hand is left unasked

ways_through.way: you learn it from the head baker, once you show her the note and let her answer in her own time
ways_through.cost: she tells you the mark is old but will not say who left it, and the owner hears you asked

ways_through.way: you learn it from the regular who left the cup on the counter, because you follow the cup to the person who marked the loaf
ways_through.cost: the regular sees you following, and the owner thinks you are making a story

turns.situation: The owner changes the display case lock and tells you the back office is not for you, while the head baker says the mark is an old habit and the regular says it is a message.
turns.what_you_must_do: get the owner to hear one account before she decides what to do with the case

ways_through.way: she hears the head baker's account, because you give her the supplier's delivery note as proof
ways_through.cost: the owner hears an ordinary explanation, and the regular's message is set aside

ways_through.way: she hears the regular's account, because you show the owner the note and let the regular speak first
ways_through.cost: the owner has to choose between the ritual and the sale in front of the regulars

ways_through.way: she hears the lock's account, because you show the owner the case lock was stuck and the loaf could have come from inside
ways_through.cost: the owner believes the case is to blame, and the person who left the loaf is not asked

turns.situation: The owner has the back office key and will not open it until the buyer leaves, and the marked loaf appears again while the regular is waiting by the counter.
turns.what_you_must_do: get the owner to open the back office before the buyer is gone

ways_through.way: she opens it, because you show her the supplier's delivery note proves the mark is not a complaint
ways_through.cost: she keeps the regular's note out of it, and the human lead stays unanswered

ways_through.way: she opens it, because you promise to keep the regulars quiet until after the buyer leaves
ways_through.cost: you have promised more quiet than the morning can hold

ways_through.way: she does not open it, because you accept the lock's explanation and let her keep the counter calm
ways_through.cost: the loaf is explained as a case problem, and the person who left it is not asked

turns.situation: The owner is about to repaint the display case plain in front of the buyer, and the marked loaf is still in the case while the regular waits to be seen.
turns.what_you_must_do: put the note where the owner can see it before she signs for the plain counter

ways_through.way: you reveal the regular's reason, because you move the note to the counter and let the regular say it aloud
ways_through.cost: the owner has to choose between the ritual and the sale in front of the regulars

ways_through.way: you reveal the supplier's note, because you put the delivery note beside the case lock
ways_through.cost: the owner repaints the case plain, and the regular's reason is not asked

ways_through.way: you conceal the note, because you move it to a shelf and let the owner see only the loaf
ways_through.cost: incorrect_resolution: the owner decides without the note, and the morning ends in lingering uncertainty

complications.description: The supplier's delivery note is dated before the owner took over, and the mark belongs to an old recipe rather than a customer.
The head baker has been taking the note to the owner each morning before you arrive.
The buyer wants to see the back office before deciding whether to buy the counter.
The regular's cup is found locked inside the display case with the loaf.

cast_seeds.wants: to complete the sale of the counter and keep the shop's reputation calm
cast_seeds.holds: the back office key, the display case lock, and the old order slips

cast_seeds.wants: to maintain the bakery's routines and avoid disrupting the staff
cast_seeds.holds: the knowledge of the mark's origin and the staff's trust

cast_seeds.wants: to understand the message of the marked loaf and be heard
cast_seeds.holds: the regular's cup and the community's attention

cast_seeds.wants: to purchase the takeaway counter and see the shop presented plainly
cast_seeds.holds: the financial offer and the decision to buy
